sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('519f2131-79e7-569f-e063-6394a90a2f93', '19546563-50b7-4160-8cbe-f8e7079cba69', '4446d4c8-056d-4bc3-8f58-21255b063398') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
